references.text: The regulation for a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering for each lamb is established here, forming the basis for the measures in Numbers 28:29.
The same measure of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour per lamb is mentioned earlier in the chapter in connection with the new moon offerings.
The instruction for a tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs is repeated in connection with the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
The same offering regulation with a tenth of an ephah per lamb is repeated for the Feast of Trumpets.
The same unit of measure, a tenth of an ephah per lamb, is also used for the Day of Atonement offerings.
Seven unblemished lambs are mentioned in connection with the Feast of Firstfruits, corresponding to the number of lambs in Numbers 28:29.
